label: preparing
what: Possibly a surprise community gathering or celebration marking my forty years as mayor, presented to me as tomorrow's 18:00 great hall lighting and readiness check. Builder and innkeeper are coordinating installed lanterns, hall arrangements, and my escorted arrival. Secretary knowingly helps schedule the visit, but I have no evidence that the secretary knows of a concealed celebration. The hidden purpose remains an inference: an ordinary lighting inspection is also consistent with what I have heard.
